briefdescription.para: Reads aligned 32-bit words from the receive FIFO.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_iRead_Aligned reads WordCount words from the FIFO referenced by InstancePtr to the block of memory referenced by BufPtr.

XLlFifo_iRead_Aligned assumes that BufPtr is already aligned according to the following hardware limitations: ppc - aligned on 32 bit boundaries to avoid performance penalties from unaligned exception handling. microblaze - aligned on 32 bit boundaries as microblaze does not handle unaligned transfers.

Care must be taken to ensure that the number of words read with one or more calls to XLlFifo_Read() does not exceed the number of bytes (rounded up to the nearest whole 32 bit word) available given from the last call to XLlFifo_RxGetLen().

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Specifies the memory address to place the data read.
Specifies the number of 32 bit words to read.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_iRead_Aligned always returns XST_SUCCESS. Error handling is otherwise handled through hardware exceptions and interrupts.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

briefdescription.para: Starts a transmit of the given byte length.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_iTxSetLen begins a hardware transfer of data out of the transmit channel of the FIFO specified by InstancePtr. Bytes specifies the number of bytes in the frame to transmit.
Note that Bytes (rounded up to the nearest whole 32-bit word) must match the number of words just written using one or more calls to XLlFifo_iWrite_Aligned().

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Specifies the number of bytes to transmit.

briefdescription.para: Writes aligned 32-bit words to the transmit FIFO.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_iWrite_Aligned writes WordCount words to the FIFO referenced by InstancePtr from the block of memory referenced by BufPtr.

XLlFifo_iWrite_Aligned assumes that BufPtr is already aligned according to the following hardware limitations: ppc - aligned on 32 bit boundaries to avoid performance penalties from unaligned exception handling. microblaze - aligned on 32 bit boundaries as microblaze does not handle unaligned transfers.

Care must be taken to ensure that the number of words written with one or more calls to XLlFifo_iWrite_Aligned() matches the number of bytes (rounded up to the nearest whole 32 bit word) given in the next call to XLlFifo_iTxSetLen().

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Specifies the memory address of the data to write.
Specifies the number of 32-bit words to write.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_iWrite_Aligned always returns XST_SUCCESS. Error handling is otherwise handled through hardware exceptions and interrupts.

briefdescription.para: Reports whether the streamer holding buffer is empty.

detaileddescription.para: XStrm_IsRxInternalEmpty returns true if the streamer, specified by InstancePtr, is not holding any bytes in it's internal buffers. Note that this routine does not reflect information about the state of the FIFO used by this streamer.

simplesect.para: XStrm_IsRxInternalEmpty returns TRUE when the streamer is not holding any bytes in it's internal buffers. Otherwise, XStrm_IsRxInternalEmpty returns FALSE.
